analysis.summary: The enrichRoutes function ignores the functionName property added to route definitions, causing Lambda functions to be created with auto-generated names instead of the specified names.

bugs.title: functionName in route definitions ignored by enrichRoutes
bugs.description: The Routes type was updated to include functionName, and route definitions now specify custom functionName values, but enrichRoutes destructures only handler/timeout/memorySize and overwrites functionName with a hardcoded generated pattern.
bugs.risk: Lambda functions will be created with names like 'BFF-PROD-GET-app-model-prod' instead of the specified '${featureAppName}-${target}-app-model', breaking infrastructure dependencies, IAM policies, or monitoring/alerting systems that reference the expected function names.

notBugs.topic: Removal of pathRewrite in webpack devServer
notBugs.reason: The removal aligns with BffApi route changes that now include the full baseUrl path in the route definitions, making path rewriting unnecessary for the proxy to correctly route to the updated API endpoints.

notBugs.topic: Removal of CloudFront function in Site.ts
notBugs.reason: The webpack output path was updated to include the __app__/featureAppName/target prefix, making the URL path stripping logic in the CloudFront function unnecessary as S3 object keys now match the request URIs.
